verdict.rationale: The evidence covers manual model choice only: picking among providers' models, passing an explicit `--model` or `model.id`, setting per-subagent models, and bringing your own API keys. Nothing documents Cursor automatically routing each task to the best model. The Auto-review classifier is a permission control, not model selection, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the tool automatically pick the best model for each task
